name: Large Hadron Collider (LHC)
location: 27 km ring, 100 m underground (Meyrin / Pays de Gex)
physicsMetric: 13.6 TeV √s · 8.33 T Nb-Ti Dipoles · 1.9 K Superfluid He
summary: The world's largest and highest-energy particle accelerator, smashing counter-rotating proton and lead-ion bunches at 99.999999% c inside four giant underground caverns.
eli5: A 27-km frozen magnetic racetrack 100 meters under Geneva that turns energy into rare cosmic particles that last existed moments after the Big Bang.

name: High-Luminosity LHC (HL-LHC)
physicsMetric: 3,000 fb⁻¹ Target · 12 T Nb₃Sn Triplets · 400 MHz Crab Cavities
summary: Major upgrade boosting LHC collision luminosity 5–10x via superconducting Nb₃Sn focusing quadrupoles, crystal collimators, and transverse crab cavities tilting bunches head-on.
eli5: Upgrades the LHC with ultra-strong magnets and RF 'crab' flippers that tilt tilted proton bunches upright just before impact, creating 10x more rare collisions!

name: Future Circular Collider (FCC-ee & FCC-hh)
location: 90.7 km ring encircling Geneva & Annecy Basin
physicsMetric: 90.7 km Circumference · 100 TeV Hadron Frontier · 16 T Dipoles
summary: Proposed successor to the LHC: first an ultra-clean Higgs/Z/top factory using electrons & positrons (FCC-ee), followed by a 100 TeV proton-proton discovery machine (FCC-hh).
eli5: A proposed 91-km underground ring—more than triple the LHC's size—built first as a precision electron factory and later a 100-trillion-volt proton frontier.

name: CLIC (Compact Linear Collider)
physicsMetric: 100 MV/m X-Band Drive Beam · 380 GeV → 3 TeV e⁺e⁻
summary: Novel two-beam linear electron-positron collider reaching 100 MV/m normal-conducting accelerating gradients, avoiding synchrotron radiation losses of circular electron rings.
eli5: Instead of curving electrons in a circle (where they radiate energy away), CLIC fires them down a laser-straight highway pushed by a parallel companion beam!

name: ATLAS & CMS Flagship Detectors
physicsMetric: 46m / 21m 3D Onions · 40 MHz Crossing → 1–3 kHz Readout
summary: Two independent 4π multi-layered detectors utilizing contrasting magnet architectures (2 T air-core toroids vs 3.8 T compact solenoid + 75,848 PbWO₄ crystals) to cross-verify new physics.
eli5: Twin seven-story 3D digital cameras built on opposite sides of the LHC using different engineering so every giant discovery—like the Higgs boson—is checked twice!

name: ALICE Heavy-Ion & QGP Spectrometer
physicsMetric: 5.5 TeV/nucleon Pb-Pb · 50 kHz Continuous TPC Readout
summary: Dedicated heavy-ion experiment recreating Quark-Gluon Plasma at >2 trillion Kelvin to measure hydrodynamic elliptic flow v₂ and jet quenching.
eli5: Smashes heavy Lead nuclei together to melt protons and neutrons into the primordial quark-gluon soup that filled the entire universe 1 microsecond after the Big Bang.

name: LHCb Heavy-Flavour & RICH Spectrometer
physicsMetric: 2 < η < 5 Forward Cone · 30 MHz Allen GPU Trigger · RICH PID
summary: Forward single-arm spectrometer placing silicon sensors 5.1 mm from beams to resolve displaced B-meson vertices, CP violation asymmetries, and Cherenkov PID rings.
eli5: Looks sideways down the beam pipe to catch short-lived Beauty quarks flying a few millimeters before decaying—testing why matter survived antimatter!

name: ISOLDE & HIE-ISOLDE Nuclear Facility
physicsMetric: 1.4 GeV Proton Spallation · >1,300 Exotic Isotopes · 10 MeV/u Post-Linac
summary: Produces rare radioactive isotopes across 74 elements via laser resonance ionization (RILIS) and high-resolution magnetic mass separators for nuclear structure, r-process astrophysics, and pear-shaped nuclei.
eli5: Fires protons at thick metal targets to cook rare, radioactive atoms that vanish in milliseconds, then bends them through magnets to sort atoms by exact weight!

name: Antimatter Factory (AD, ELENA, ALPHA-g, BASE)
physicsMetric: 3.57 GeV/c → 100 keV Cooling · ALPHA-g Gravity Drop · 10¹² CPT Precision
summary: World's unique deceleration complex slowing antiprotons down 35,000x to synthesize cold antihydrogen atoms in Penning traps, proving in 2023 that antimatter falls downward under gravity.
eli5: Instead of speeding particles up, CERN's Antimatter Factory hits the brakes! It traps antihydrogen atoms inside magnetic bottles and drops them to check if antimatter falls down.

name: AWAKE Plasma Wakefield Accelerator
physicsMetric: 400 GeV SPS Drive Beam · 10 m Rubidium Plasma · >1 GV/m Gradient
summary: World's first proton-driven plasma wakefield experiment demonstrating accelerating gradients ~100x stronger than conventional copper RF cavities.
eli5: Uses an SPS proton beam like a speedboat cutting through ionized rubidium gas—electrons surf behind on plasma waves to gain huge energy in just 10 meters!

name: CLEAR Linear Electron Accelerator (FLASH Therapy)
physicsMetric: 60 – 220 MeV Electrons · Sub-millisecond FLASH Radiotherapy
summary: Versatile user facility testing novel beam instrumentation, CLIC high-gradient X-band structures, space electronics radiation hardness, and ultra-high-dose-rate FLASH cancer radiotherapy.

name: NA62 & NA64 North Area Fixed-Target Experiments
physicsMetric: 400 GeV SPS Protons · K⁺ → π⁺νν̄ (BR ~ 10⁻¹⁰) · Dark Sector Dump
summary: Precision rare-decay and dark-sector programme probing 1-in-10-billion kaon decays (NA62) and invisible dark-photon / axion-like missing-energy dumps (NA64).

name: CLOUD Cosmic-Ray & Climate Chamber
physicsMetric: 3.5 GeV/c PS Pion Beam · 26 m³ Stainless Ultra-Pure Aerosol Tank
summary: Uses a charged pion beam from the Proton Synchrotron as tunable artificial cosmic rays to quantify how ions nucleate atmospheric aerosols and cloud droplets for climate models.

name: n_TOF Neutron Time-of-Flight Facility
location: CERN Meyrin (185 m & 20 m Underground Flight Paths)
physicsMetric: 20 GeV PS Proton Spallation · meV → GeV Neutron Spectroscopy

location: TI12 & TI18 Service Tunnels (480 m from ATLAS)

name: CAST & BabyIAXO Solar Axion Telescopes
physicsMetric: 9.26 m LHC Prototype Dipole · 9.0 T · g_aγ < 6.6×10⁻¹¹ GeV⁻¹

name: World Wide Web (HTTP, HTML, URL)
